name: Grok CLI
description: Community terminal coding agent for xAI's Grok models with web and X search, sub-agents and remote control over Telegram.
whatItDoes: Grok CLI lets developers use Grok models to edit code and run commands in a project. It can search the web and X for up-to-date information and split work across sub-agents. It is not published by xAI.
howItWorks: The CLI runs an agent loop against the Grok API with file, shell and search tools. It works interactively or headless with a prompt flag, and a Telegram bridge lets a session be steered remotely.
run: grok --prompt "run the test suite and summarize failures"
